To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“Uncertainty annotation of web (and its reasoning) is possible, useful and necessary for the Semantic Web”.
the URW3G project is a very important and timely project that can significantly improve current practice of semantic web.
the uncertainty reasoning is an important part of semantic web practice and that the URW3 ontology is a suitable tool for annotation and reasoning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
uncertainty annotation of web pages and its reasoning.
a) ontology modeling of the domain, b) annotation of web pages with uncertain information, c) data mining of the annotated data, d) reasoning on the data, and e) evaluation of the results.

a combination of the above tasks, namely: (i) data mining to identify the uncertainty in the web data, (ii) ontology design and modeling to represent the uncertainty in the data, and (iii) ontology reasoning to reason about the uncertain data and to provide a basis for the annotation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we are ready to start with this work, we have the data, the tools and the knowledge.
URW3XGs objective of “improving semantic web practice through uncertainty reasoning” is achievable and the URW3G group should focus on the refinement of use cases and on ontology modeling.
we have a vision and we are working on it.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have a good idea of what to do but still we have to do it.
we have a working prototype for annotation and reasoning based on uncertain reasoning, and we have a plan for a future extension of this prototype.
we have created and evaluated an ontology for uncertain annotation of web pages and we have shown how this ontology can be applied to real world web data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to create a large ontology of web pages, which is a necessary prerequisite to the use of uncertainty reasoning on web.
the ontology modeling task is not trivial and that the ontology modeling should be done in a collaborative way.
we can create an ontology that will be used to semantically annotate web pages and we have an infrastructure to support the creation and maintenance of this ontology.
